content:
Security operations teams usually write reports to record important information, including what
response actions were taken and the corresponding results, the team members involved, and
other information to aid future security decisions and learning. Oftentimes, documenting
incidents can be time-consuming. For an incident report to be effective, it must contain an
incident's summary along with the actions taken, including what actions were taken by whom
and when. Copilot generates an incident report by quickly consolidating these pieces of
information.

